values.note: 18 sites: 15 dead-end spurs and 3 pull-throughs, with ample turn-around and trailer parking. 'Maximum spur length is 45 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/lower-beaver-creek-campground ('18 sites with tables and fireplaces'; '15 sites are dead end spurs and 3 sites are pull through spurs'; 'Maximum spur length is 45 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Hand-pump drinking water and trash service only in the summer season (Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend); off-season no water, pack out trash.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/lower-beaver-creek-campground ('vault type toilets, centralized refuse bin and a developed drinking water system with hand pumps (in season)'; 'Outside of the summer season, potable water is NOT available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: The full campground is open Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend (2026 concessionaire season from May 22); 5 sites stay open year-round at a reduced fee with no water or trash, and may be snowed in or behind spring road closures.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/lower-beaver-creek-campground ('The full campground is open from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend. 5 of the campsites remain open year-round, but may be inaccessible due to snow levels or spring road closures'; 'Concessionaire operations for the 2026 season begin May 22nd'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Pay at the fee box by the entrance, cash or check.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/lower-beaver-creek-campground ('All sites are first come, first served and cannot be reserved'; '14-day camping limit'; 'Fee envelopes and a collection box are provided near the entrance'; 'Please be prepared to pay with cash or check'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $27 single / $54 double in the summer season; $10 a night off-season (no services).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/lower-beaver-creek-campground ('Single Site: $27 per night', 'Double Site: $54 per night', 'Single Site: $10 per night (during shoulder season)'; 'Off-season fees of $10.00/night apply'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 50% off single campsites only, for the site the pass holder occupies.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/lower-beaver-creek-campground ('Interagency Senior/Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites ONLY'), read 2026-10-28

note: Concessionaire-run (summer) USFS campground in the Beaver Creek drainage, 1 mi south of South Fork on US-160 then 4.5 mi south on gravel Forest Rd 360, below Beaver Creek Reservoir (boat ramp, no-wake). --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 18 sites (3 pull-through), max spur 45 ft, vault toilets, seasonal hand-pump water, FCFS only, $10-27 (2026), phone 719-657-3321 (Divide RD); added season (year-round for 5 sites, full campground Memorial Day-Labor Day), 14-night limit, senior-pass discount. Hookups left alone (page silent). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Phone 719-657-3321 confirmed: Divide Ranger District, Del Norte (FS page contact block).

Road: FR 360 (Beaver Creek) 'Open' on the Divide district road table (last updated June 11, 2026). The Rio Grande NF's October 22-23, 2026 flood-damage list names FSR 410, 380, 390, 430 and 438 on Divide, not 360. No RV or 4WD advice for FR 360.
Status: FS banner 'Site Open'; 'Campground is currently in off season: No water, trash, or camp host. All sites are first-come, first-served.'
